intro: Colossians is about who Jesus is: above all things, and all you need.

Chapters one and two show Christ as the image of the invisible God, and warn against teachings that add to him. Chapters three and four describe the new life: setting your mind on things above, and living it out at home.
Paul wrote it from prison, to a church he had never visited.
Listen for chapter three: set your affection on things above.

card.parts: Ch. 1–2: Christ above all | Ch. 3–4: the new life
card.key: The image of God (1) · Things above (3)
